messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] pegasus-14b (us-west) RPM spike > 95th pct threshold. Pager triggered for on-call. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/pegasus-14b/us-west

sam: paging oncall — seeing huge retries and increased tail latency. looks like a sudden client spike to pegasus-14b.

priya: on it. checking runbook (runbook: https://wiki.redwood/playbooks/model-rate-surge). any customer-facing errors yet?

matt_b: customer telemetry shows 2 customers with >30% error rate on generate endpoints (customer IDs redacted). they reported timeouts and 502s.

linh: logs show queue growth on inference pool peg-14b-pool-3, KV cache thrash. mostly long-context requests too. sample trace: `req_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate seq=2048`

priya: proposal: surgical per-model TPM/RPM trim for pegasus-14b in us-west to relieve tail. drop TPM -> 8, RPM -> 40 for 20m, keep fallback routing to pegasus-6b. feedback?

sam: good plan. can we avoid whole-account rate-limits? want to target model family only.

eng-runtime-bot: available mitigation API: POST /internal/mitigations/quota with body {model, region, tpm, rpm, duration_minutes}. requires oncall token.

matt_b: need to notify support and CS before throttle. I'll ping CS and list impacted customers + mitigation window.

priya: executing now. using oncall token.

```bash
# temporary quota carve for pegasus-14b us-west
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/mitigations/quota \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"pegasus-14b","region":"us-west","tpm":8,"rpm":40,"duration_minutes":20}'
```

eng-runtime-bot: 200 OK — mitigation applied. policy_id=mit-202503-pegasus14b-usw. active_from=2578912345 active_until=2578913545

sam: confirmed in control plane UI, queue depth decreasing on pool-3. latency p95 improving.

linh: streaming has been disabled for pegasus-14b in us-west as part of mitigation (to reduce long-running conns). that may affect some customers using streaming SDK.

matt_b: CS update: sent message to impacted customers, offering retry to pegasus-6b or temp SLA credit. cc @support.

priya: open question — do we want to enable a selective uplift for internal partner `partner-alpha`? they are latency-sensitive.

sam: don't allow exceptions for now. we need to ensure overall system stability.

priya: fair. I'll keep monitor for 15m and then reassess. creating an incident tracker entry: https://incidents.redwood/INC-202503-pegasus-rate 

linh: quick data dump from logs (last 5m): total requests to pegasus-14b = 18k, error rate 18% -> after mitigation: 7k, error rate 4%

sre-oncall: nice work. any planned rollback?

priya: plan: keep mitigation for 20m, if metrics stay healthy, lift throttle gradually back to default over 10m. rollback steps in runbook. I'll handoff to sam for next 30m after I step out.

sam: ack. I'll watch the dashboard and continue checks. will escalate to eng-sre if errors climb.

matt_b: adding post-mortem checklist: root-cause hypotheses, client patterns (long contexts), KV cache tuning, consider auto-eviction policy. tagging eng-ml for model-level perf tuning.

priya: note for post-incident: consider recording a per-model circuit-breaker policy so heavy single-model clients don't saturate pools.

sam: :thumbsup: good call. finishing handoff — oncall coverage with sam for next 30m. Priya — please leave update in incident tracker when you bounce.

eng-runtime-bot: mitigation policy mit-202503-pegasus14b-usw scheduled to expire at 2578913545.

priya: leaving handoff. thanks all.

sam: closing thread for now, will reopen if we see regressions.
